name: Veea Inc.

marketCap.source: Derived: ~2.52M post-split shares (see sharesOutstanding note) x $5.70 close on 2026-10-09
marketCap.note: This is a calculated estimate, not a directly-sourced market-cap figure, flagged as such. No aggregator market-cap figure dated after the Aug 2026 reverse split was found.

float.note: not found in available sources; see shortInterest conflicts for float-related figures that could not be reconciled

sharesOutstanding.source: Derived from last confirmed pre-split count (50,407,567 shares as of 2026-05-13, per Q1 2026 10-Q cover page) divided by the announced 1-for-20 reverse split ratio effective 2026-08-31
sharesOutstanding.note: This is an arithmetic estimate based on disclosed figures, not a directly observed post-split share count -- no 10-Q or 8-K filed after the split with an updated share count was reachable in sandbox. The company also filed a Form 424B5 (securities offering prospectus) around mid-August 2026, which may have added shares after this count; treat as approximate and likely a floor.

shortInterest.note: Could not establish a reliable figure -- sources are wildly inconsistent and dated across different pre/post-split periods: Benzinga ~0.68% (late 2025); Equibles 0.8% of float (2026-07-02, pre-split); Chartmill 4.38% of float (undated); a Benzinga Korean-language page cites 35.7% short float (dated near the Sept 2026 NovaGen news); Tickeron cites 'about 39% of shares sold short' (Oct 2026); Quiverquant headline cites short interest 'rises to 64.77%' (undated). These cannot be reconciled in this sandbox and are recorded verbatim in conflicts.

cash.source: Third-party earnings analysis (panabee.com), summarizing the Q2 2026 10-Q -- NOT independently confirmed against the primary filing (sec.gov unreachable in sandbox)
cash.note: Same source states the company remains dependent on related-party debt from its CEO and affiliated entities (e.g., NLabs) to fund operations, and that accrued rent/debt has been converted into Series A Preferred Stock.

debt.note: No clean total-debt figure found; disclosed as primarily related-party debt from the CEO/affiliates per third-party summary, amount not quantified in available sources.

pe.note: negative earnings -- company reported an operating loss of ~$12.2M against ~$0.4M of revenue for H1 2026; pre-revenue-stage economics, no analyst forward estimate found.

eps.note: Operating loss of ~$12.2M disclosed (third-party summary) but no per-share figure found; most recent discrete quarter's EPS not isolated from the half-year figure in available sources.

growth.note: Growth is off a very small base (~$0.4M vs ~$0.1M); not indicative of a mature revenue ramp. Company is effectively pre-revenue for its edge-infrastructure business as filed.

catalysts.headline: Shares rose 47.3% to $5.70 after the company said it resolved remaining governance deficiencies and regained full Nasdaq listing compliance (announced 2026-10-08)

Signed a non-binding term sheet for a business combination with NovaGen Group B.V. (regenerative medicine/longevity) to form 'NovaGen Health Networks'; implied combined valuation ~$750M (management estimate); GeoNova Capital signed a term sheet for a proposed $10M investment. Parties targeted execution of a definitive agreement 'within the coming weeks' -- STILL NOT EXECUTED as of the most recent information found in this session (no October 2026 definitive-agreement filing located)
catalysts.source: SEC 8-K (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001840317/000121390026100507/ea0305721-8k_veea.htm -- content relayed via WebSearch, direct fetch unreachable in sandbox)

catalysts.headline: Signed a non-binding term sheet for a business combination with NovaGen Group B.V. (a regenerative medicine/longevity company) to launch 'NovaGen Health Networks', implying a combined-company valuation of roughly $750M; GeoNova Capital committing $10M as a cornerstone investor

1-for-20 reverse stock split took effect; trading began on a split-adjusted basis at market open 2026-08-31 (ticker unchanged: VEEA; new CUSIP 693489205); public warrants adjusted to 1/20 share at $230 exercise price per whole share
catalysts.source: Nasdaq.com press release / company 8-K, per WebSearch summary

catalysts.headline: Announced the reverse stock split (board approved ratio 2026-08-10; stockholders had approved a split range at the 2025-12-30 annual meeting)

conflicts: Short interest estimates range from ~0.7% to ~65% of float/shares across sources and dates -- could not be reconciled; recorded as a conflict rather than resolved.

Price appears to jump from $0.23 (2026-07-02, equibles) to a $3.87-$5.70 range in October 2026 (various sources) -- this is very likely explained by the 1-for-20 reverse stock split effective 2026-08-31 (pre-split $0.23 x 20 ~= $4.60, consistent with the October range), rather than a real anomaly; flagged per instructions rather than silently adjusted.

Share count: a Benzinga page shows 19,070,336 shares (late 2025) vs. the Q1 2026 10-Q's 50,407,567 shares (as of 2026-05-13) -- a large jump that was not explained by any single source found (likely dilution/offerings over the period); the post-split (~2.52M) figure used above is a derived estimate, not directly observed.

A Benzinga Korean-language page lists a $5.84 price alongside '35.7% short float,' which is roughly consistent with the October price range but was not fully cross-checked against the Quiver Quant $5.70 figure for the same window.
notes: PM pass 2026-10-23: nothing new. No catalysts found beyond the 2026-10-09 Nasdaq-compliance item already on file. The NovaGen Group business combination remains a non-binding term sheet as of this session's search -- no definitive agreement, termination, or other update located (one secondary aggregator's Oct 5 item simply repeats the Sept 14 term-sheet announcement with no new terms). Price data remains too inconsistent across sources to establish a reliable current market cap (a Digrin monthly series shows ~$5.70 for Oct 2026 vs ~$0.49 in June 2026), consistent with the reverse-split-driven conflict already flagged on file -- not re-resolved this session.

recoveredFrom.caveat: Reconstructed by parsing a previously-published dashboard page, not re-researched from primary sources. Monetary figures are back-converted from the page's rounded K/M/B/T display and are approximate. Re-verify on this ticker's next due full pass.
